description: This PHP class 'EmployeeDependentsController' handles HTTP requests related to employee dependents within the OrangeHRM human resource management system. It sets up a Vue component for rendering dependents data and manages permission checks based on employee number passed via the request.

classes.name: EmployeeDependentsController
classes.description: Controller class for managing employee dependents, extending base functionality to load dependents view and handle permissions.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the dependents component with employee number props if available, sets up permissions or handles bad request.

methods.name: getDataGroupsForCapabilityCheck
methods.description: Returns the data group 'dependents' for capability permission checks.
